evals.name: handover-to-customer-success-eval-1
evals.expected_output: The note states intake time (about twenty minutes, target under ten by the end of the first quarter), Mina as the rollout owner with four hours a week, and three nervous front-desk users. The eligibility check is listed as planned later, and the note flags that the customer understood it as included. The go-live date is marked as the rep's plan, not confirmed.
expectations: Every section in the rubric is present, in order
Every claim cites a quote, a timestamp, or a column and cell
Anything the input does not say is written as not stated, not guessed
No fact from outside the input appears
A rep claim that the other side never accepted is not written as agreed
Flags the gap between what Dr. Okafor understood about the eligibility check and what was true
Marks the go-live date as unconfirmed by the onboarding team

evals.name: handover-to-customer-success-eval-2-thin-input
evals.prompt: run handover-to-customer-success on a very short input that supports only one or two items
evals.expected_output: The output is short and does not invent items to fill the sections. Missing items are written as not stated.
expectations: The output does not pad to reach a count
Missing information is written as not stated
